rules.retrieved_snippet: ILGA: private entities must publish a retention/destruction policy and obtain written notice and a written release before collecting biometric identifiers (retina/iris scans, fingerprints, voiceprints, hand or face geometry); private right of action with $1,000 negligent / $5,000 intentional or reckless damages. SB 3122 (2026) proposing changes was seen only as introduced.

rules.source: Public Act 103-0804 (HB 3773), amending the Illinois Human Rights Act — https://ilga.gov/Documents/Legislation/PublicActs/103/PDF/103-0804.pdf
rules.retrieved_snippet: ILGA: signed Aug. 9, 2024, effective Jan. 1, 2026; makes it a civil rights violation for employers to use AI that discriminates against protected classes in employment decisions or to use zip codes as a proxy, and requires notice to employees when AI is used for these purposes.
